theory.title: Present perfect y pasado simple
theory.explanation: Usa el pasado simple para hablar de un momento pasado ya terminado. Usa el present perfect para experiencias o acciones pasadas conectadas con el presente. No combines el present perfect con expresiones de tiempo terminado como yesterday (ayer) o in 2022 (en 2022).
theory.tip: Present perfect = experiencia conectada con el presente; pasado simple = momento pasado terminado.

content.passage: Nora has always enjoyed learning new things. She completed her first computer course in 2022, and since then she has taken several online classes. Last month, she attended a weekend workshop on presentation skills. She has already used some of the techniques at work, and her manager has noticed the difference. Nora has not decided which qualification to study next, but she wants to keep improving. She believes that learning is useful at every stage of life.
